resolved.title: 代码注释
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定的代码，输出 "C++很难学"和 "C++很简单"。

清注释，仅打印"C++很简单"。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given some code, which outputs "C++ is hard" and "C++ is cool".

[h3][b]Task[/b][/h3]
[b]Comment [/b]out[b] [/b]the first line to print only "C++ is cool".

[note]Use // to comment out a line.[/note]

resolved.title: 多行注释
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][/s0l0!-header][s0l0!-header][h1]Multi-Line Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Comments that require multiple lines begin with [b]/*[/b] and end with [b]*/[/b]
You can place them on the same line or insert one or more lines between them.[code format="cpp" codeId="4934"]/*We are going to
    print "Hello world!" */

    cout << "Hello world!"; // prints Hello world![/code]
[note]Comments can be written anywhere, and can be repeated any number of times throughout the code.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][/s0l0!-header][s0l0!-header][h1]Multi-Line Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Comments that require multiple lines begin with [b]/*[/b] and end with [b]*/[/b]
You can place them on the same line or insert one or more lines between them.[code format="cpp" codeId="4934"]/*We are going to
    print "Hello world!" */

    cout << "Hello world!"; // prints Hello world![/code]
[note]Comments can be written anywhere, and can be repeated any number of times throughout the code.[/note]

content.text:
需要多行的注释以`/*`开始，并以`*/`结束。
你可以把它们放在同一行，或在它们之间插入一行或多行文本。
content.text_html:
Comments that require multiple lines begin with /* and end with */ You can place them on the same line or insert one or more lines between them.

需要多行的注释以**/开始，以/**结束。 你可以把它们放在同一行，或在它们之间插入一行或多行。

content.text: 注释可以写在任何地方，并且可以在整个代码中重复任意次数。
